# Runtime fixture provenance

`runtime-house.glb` is the Meshopt derivative of the repository's generated demo house, produced by `asset-tools/process.mjs` for loader and ownership tests.

`runtime-uastc.ktx2` is Three.js's `examples/textures/ktx2/2d_uastc.ktx2` from release r186, downloaded from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r186/examples/textures/ktx2/2d_uastc.ktx2. Three.js is distributed under the MIT license; see https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r186/LICENSE. It exercises real Basis transcoding in the browser acceptance test.
